name: Aspartic acid
info: At a pH of about 7, the side-chain carboxylate is predominantly negatively charged. The ionized form is aspartate.

history.clue: It was first obtained by hydrolyzing asparagine, and its name preserves that connection.
history.story: In 1827, aspartic acid was obtained by hydrolyzing the already known asparagine. In this process, the side-chain amide group is converted into a carboxyl group. The name retained its relationship to asparagine and, through it, to asparagus, from whose juice asparagine had been isolated.
